summary: Docker images for Temporal Server 1.30.4.1 and Admin Tools 1.30.4.1 contain known CVEs that require security patching. Server image has CVE-2026-41602, while admin-tools has CVE-2026-40890 and CVE-2026-41602.
userImpact: Users running Temporal 1.30.4.1 Docker images are exposed to known security vulnerabilities and need to upgrade.
